title: AudioState
description: A named state axis that any audio object can subscribe to. Server-authority axes are driven by server logic and broadcast to clients. Client-authority axes are driven locally on the client (e.g. by AmbienceFX SetStates).
markdownDescription: A named state axis that any audio object can subscribe to. Server-authority axes are driven by server logic and broadcast to clients. Client-authority axes are driven locally on the client (e.g. by AmbienceFX SetStates).

Parent.description:
When set this asset will inherit properties from the named asset.

When inheriting from another AudioState most properties will simply be copied from the parent asset to this asset. In the case where both child and parent provide a field the child field will simply replace the value provided by the parent, in the case of nested structures this will apply to the fields within the structure. In some cases the field may decide to act differently, for example: by merging the parent and child fields together.

Tags.title: Map
Tags.description:
Tags are a general way to describe an asset that can be interpreted by other systems in a way they see fit.

For example you could tag something with a Material tag with the values Solid and Stone, And another single tag Ore.

Tags will be expanded into a single list of tags automatically. Using the above example with Material and Ore the end result would be the following list of tags: Ore, Material, Solid, Stone, Material=Solid and Material=Stone.
Tags.markdownDescription:
Tags are a general way to describe an asset that can be interpreted by other systems in a way they see fit.

For example you could tag something with a **Material** tag with the values **Solid** and **Stone**, And another single tag **Ore**.

Tags will be expanded into a single list of tags automatically. Using the above example with **Material** and **Ore** the end result would be the following list of tags: **Ore**, **Material**, **Solid**, **Stone**, **Material=Solid** and **Material=Stone**.

Authority.description: Server: written on the server and broadcast. Client: written locally by AmbienceFX SetStates.

Values.description: Ordered list of state value names on this axis.
Values.markdownDescription: Ordered list of state value names on this axis.

DefaultValue.description: State value name the axis reports as active before any explicit setting.
DefaultValue.markdownDescription: State value name the axis reports as active before any explicit setting.

DefaultSyncTo.title: SyncPoint
DefaultSyncTo.description: Default sync point for transitions on this axis. Overridden per-edge or per-call.
DefaultSyncTo.markdownDescription: Default sync point for transitions on this axis. Overridden per-edge or per-call.

DefaultTransition.description: Fallback transition used when no edge matches the from/to pair. Omission means no default is provided (transition immediately in 0 ms).
DefaultTransition.markdownDescription: Fallback transition used when no edge matches the from/to pair. Omission means no default is provided (transition immediately in 0 ms).

Transitions.description: Per-edge transition settings keyed by From/To state value names. '*' wildcards supported.
Transitions.markdownDescription: Per-edge transition settings keyed by From/To state value names. '*' wildcards supported.

RevertWhenInactive.description: When true, the axis reverts to DefaultValue when every active AmbienceFX that was writing it goes inactive and no new writer claims it. Only meaningful for Authority: Client axes.
RevertWhenInactive.markdownDescription: When true, the axis reverts to DefaultValue when every active AmbienceFX that was writing it goes inactive and no new writer claims it. Only meaningful for Authority: Client axes.
